title: Dirac Dice
description: Simulate a board game with deterministic and quantum dice.
writeup:
## Approach

Two players take turns rolling a die and advancing on a circular 1–10 board, scoring points equal to their landing position.

## Part 1

A deterministic die cycles 1–100. Simulate turns until a player reaches 1000 points. The answer is the losing player's score times total die rolls.

## Part 2

A quantum (Dirac) die splits the universe into 3 outcomes per roll. With 3 rolls per turn, there are 27 universe splits, but only 7 distinct sums (3–9) with known frequencies. Memoized recursion on `(p1_pos, p2_pos, p1_score, p2_score, turn)` efficiently counts how many universes each player wins. The state space is bounded: positions 1–10 and scores 0–20, giving at most ~44,100 unique states.
